source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: When a tanky enemy dives you, Assault Mode drains your mana fast; flip back to Sentry Mode and walk away before you run dry.
offlane.rewrite: When a tanky enemy runs at you, Assault Mode drains your mana fast; flip back to Sentry Mode and walk away before you run dry.

offlane.quote: Steel, Grux and Zarus all win this lane up close; when they walk at you, back off and poke with Soulfire instead.
offlane.rewrite: Steel, Grux and Zarus all win this lane up close; when they walk at you, back off and hit them from range with Soulfire instead.

midlane.quote: Open with Hail of Arrows to slow them, then use Heightened Senses for attack speed and keep basic attacking one target to build Relentless stacks. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, finish with a charged Piercing Shot or Inner Fire on the stacked target.
midlane.issue: Relentless stacks boost Piercing Shot, not Inner Fire
midlane.rewrite: Open with Hail of Arrows to slow them, then use Heightened Senses for attack speed and keep basic attacking one target to build Relentless stacks. Once Deathstalker and Viper are done, finish the stacked target with a charged Piercing Shot, then Inner Fire.
